candidate.description: PROC-500 Talent Flow — join path evaluation. Two join dimensions assessed: (1) Process-to-fleet identity join via HEIR sovereign_ref → imo-creator fleet registry, and (2) Data-output-to-spine join via signal_output → outreach_id. The process must attach to the system at both the document level (fleet identity) and the runtime level (data spine). The map artifact (03-map.json) established 28 source-to-target mappings. This stage evaluates whether those mapped elements can resolve a path to the spine ID at each level.

hops.mechanism: SQL lookup — talent-flow.py queries people_master WHERE unique_id matches snapshot person_id
Bridge table — person_unique_id maps unique_id to outreach_id
Direct — outreach_id IS the spine. Signal_output rows written with this join key are Grid Reader compatible for Process 100 consumption.

fleet_identity_path.mechanism: Direct — sovereign_ref names the fleet. hub_id = PROC-TALENT-FLOW. ctb_placement = leaf under factory/outreach/. Process is addressable in the fleet registry.

test_results.data_spine_evidence: OSAM section declares join chain person_id → unique_id → person_unique_id → outreach_id. Signal_output table schema includes outreach_id column. 3-hop indirect join with all intermediate tables declared in READ table (03-map.json E09 confirms L9 maps directly).
test_results.fleet_identity_evidence: heir.yaml exists with 8/8 fields populated. sovereign_ref = imo-creator matches fleet registry. PROC-500 is addressable. Note: heir.yaml field VALUES have inconsistencies (runtime, snap_on_tools, ut_sub_hubs contradict PROCESS.md) — tracked as E25 in define/map — but the JOIN PATH itself resolves. Value correction is a define-stage concern, not a join-stage concern.
test_results.grid_reader_evidence: Output writes to signal_output with outreach_id as join key. Process 100 (LCS Grid) can consume these signals via standard Grid Reader pattern. Downstream consumer declared in IMO output block.

join_hop_count.measurement: Number of intermediate hops from process output to spine ID. Direct = 0, indirect = N hops. Lower hop count = simpler join, less fragility. 3 hops: person_id → unique_id → person_unique_id → outreach_id.

unresolvable_hop_count.measurement: Number of hops in the join chain where the intermediate table or column is NOT declared in the OSAM READ table or does not exist in the database schema. 0 = all hops have declared intermediates.

join_path_ambiguity_count.measurement: Number of hops where multiple candidate paths exist and no deterministic selector is declared. Ambiguous joins produce non-deterministic results. 0 = every hop has exactly one path.

missing_dmj_join_format.measurement: Whether the join path is expressed in the formal L21 DMJ Join Step format (Join Path, Type, Description — 3-column table) in the source PROCESS.md. 1 = absent (join data exists in OSAM but not in L21 format), 0 = present. The join path RESOLVES but is not in the structural format required by the invariant set.

fleet_identity_gap_count.measurement: Number of fleet identity fields (sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement) that fail to resolve to the fleet registry. 0 = all 3 resolve. Note: value inconsistencies in heir.yaml (E25) are define-stage deviations, not join-path failures — the path resolves even when the values at the endpoint are wrong.
